description_en: Queries the body, summary, conclusion status, and analysis time of a specified AI analysis report
description_zh: 查询指定 AI 分析报告的正文、摘要、结论状态和分析时间
name: DescribeIncidentInvestigation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI analysis report. You can obtain this value from [ListIncidentInvestigations](~~ListIncidentInvestigations~~)
parameters.help_zh: AI 分析报告 ID，可从 ListIncidentInvestigations 获取
parameters.name: incident_investigation_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned content. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回内容的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文，默认中文
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en: The data returned by the query or operation
Data.description_zh: 查询结果或操作返回数据

IncidentInvestigationEndTime.description_en: The end time of the AI analysis. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
IncidentInvestigationEndTime.description_zh: AI 分析结束时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
IncidentInvestigationEndTime.title_en: AI分析结束时间（秒级时间戳）
IncidentInvestigationEndTime.title_zh: AI分析结束时间（秒级时间戳）

IncidentInvestigationId.description_en: The ID of the AI analysis report. You can obtain this value from [ListIncidentInvestigations](~~ListIncidentInvestigations~~)
IncidentInvestigationId.description_zh: AI 分析报告 ID，可从 ListIncidentInvestigations 获取

IncidentInvestigationReport.description_en: The body of the AI analysis report in Markdown format
IncidentInvestigationReport.description_zh: AI 分析报告正文，采用 Markdown 格式
IncidentInvestigationReport.example:
## 分析结论
发现攻击尝试，建议核对目标资产。

IncidentInvestigationStartTime.description_en: The start time of the AI analysis. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
IncidentInvestigationStartTime.description_zh: AI 分析开始时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
IncidentInvestigationStartTime.title_en: AI分析开始时间（秒级时间戳）
IncidentInvestigationStartTime.title_zh: AI分析开始时间（秒级时间戳）

IncidentInvestigationStatus.description_en: The conclusion status of the AI analysis report. This is not the execution status of an asynchronous task
IncidentInvestigationStatus.description_zh: AI 分析报告的结论状态，不是异步任务执行状态

IncidentInvestigationSummary.description_en: The summary of the AI analysis report
IncidentInvestigationSummary.example: 发现攻击尝试，建议核对目标资产。

IncidentUuid.description_en: The ID of the security incident. You can obtain this value from [ListIncidents](~~ListIncidents~~)
IncidentUuid.description_zh: 安全事件 ID，可从 ListIncidents 获取

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request failed

Message.description_en: The description of the request result or the failure reason
Message.description_zh: 请求结果说明或失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查请求问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
